title: Research: joint late-entrance obstruction for PR589 (no new kappa)
body:
Two helper-entrance directions can each pass a late-compensation test while failing the joint boundary. This package resolves the simultaneous-entrance question explicitly left unrun in PR1932 for the pinned PR589 common-first-contact model.

The exact census of all **4,954 eligible support columns** leaves `{444,470}` and `{444,470,578}` individually admissible. At eight physical targets, their joint response is `(0,1)`, while accessible source-free helper values map only into `span{(1,1)}`. The separating vector `(1,1)` proves that both directions cannot be used for independent elevated inputs. Consequently **the joint entrance rank is at most one** in this model.

`PROOF.md` derives the joint condition for fixed A/scatter, helper-only entrance columns and arbitrary monotone post-scatter linear compensation with restored dirty registers. It inherits PR1253's complete rational common-frame closure and rechecks each eligible helper set against the word. The new checker imports no predecessor Python implementation and rederives the 661-column raw operator, access spaces and support census.

**Limits:** the single triple `{444,470,578}` remains an open construction. Source-donor entrances, changed A/first contacts, new COPY operations and altered endpoints are outside the theorem. This is a scoped negative result, with no new circuit, hosted invoice, selected-frontier change or kappa claim. PR1179's known one-unit local rank saving is credited as inherited evidence, not rerun.

Validation passed:
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-joint-late-entrance-bound` — exact source pins, complete census, eight separating witnesses, four rejected controls, four positive controls, six invertible basis changes and exact certificate equality.
- `git diff --cached --check`.

Only `research/r439-joint-late-entrance-bound/` is added. Base `ae95f60feec79897b153dba6459bb3f9fd4d7b8e`; OS assignment seed 0, refined `bit-helper-contract` card. PR1932 is pinned at `d5e6ac0e442a1acfd0ac933af90a2adfb3417138`; [claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1971).

Credit: Sagar Thakrar (PR1932), Philipp/@mightyOil (PR1253), Adam Gall (PR1179), Ali Romman (PR1128), DreamingOfClouds (PR589), and eumemic (PR555). Prepared by Matthieu Pascal (@mtpsl) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
